function.name: make_webapi_call
function.description: Executes a call to a specified Web API endpoint with given parameters and returns the response. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

endpoint.description: The URL of the Web API endpoint to be called.

method.description: The HTTP method to be used for the API call.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request.

Content-Type.description: The media type of the resource being requested or submitted.

params.description: Query parameters to be appended to the endpoint URL.

query.description: The search term for the query.

body.description: The JSON payload to be sent with POST, PUT, or PATCH requests.

data.description: The actual data to be sent in the request body.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for a server response before timing out. This is a float type value.

Sure thing! Finding a three‑bedroom place in Zürich can feel overwhelming at first glance—there’s so many districts, price points, and listing sites to sift through. Let me start by gathering a bit more detail from you; once I know your priorities, I’ll point you toward the best places to look and even draft a quick “search checklist” you can copy into your favorite portal. --- ### Quick Clarification Questions (Feel free to skip ones that don’t apply.) | # | Question | Why it matters | |---|----------|----------------| | **1** | What’s your maximum monthly rent budget? | Helps filter out overpriced options early. | | **2** | Which parts of Zürich do you prefer? (e.g., city centre, Enge, Seefeld, Oerlikon, Zollikon) | Different districts have distinct vibes & prices. | | **3** | When would you ideally move in? | Some listings only open after certain dates. | | **4** | Do you need parking/garage space? | Parking spots add cost but may be essential if you own a car. | | **5** | Are there particular building features you care about? (e.g., balcony, elevator, pet-friendly, furnished) | Narrow down the list quickly. | | **6** | How important is proximity to public transit / work/school? | Determines which neighborhoods fit your commute needs. | Once you’ve answered those, here’s a tailored plan: --- ## Step‑by‑Step Search Plan | Stage | Action | Suggested Resources | |-------|--------|---------------------| | **A. Define Your Ideal Profile** | Use answers above to create a *“must‑have vs nice‑to‑have”* matrix. | N/A | | **B. Set Up Alerts** | Most portals let you save searches + email alerts. | • [Homegate](https://www.homegate.ch/)
• [ImmoScout24](https://www.immoscout24.ch/en)
• [Newhome](https://newhome.ch/en) | | **C. Filter by District & Price** | Start broad, then narrow using filters. | Same portals – they all support district & price range filtering. | | **D. Check Building Amenities** | Look for elevators, laundry rooms, storage, security gates, etc. | Built‑in property details pages. | | **E. Verify Public Transport Access** | Map the address → check S-Bahn/BUS stops within 10–15 min walk. | Google Maps / Swiss Federal Railways website. | | **F. Contact Agents Quickly** | Send concise messages including your ID, proof of income, and preferred move‑in date. | Email templates below. | | **G. Schedule Viewings** | Prioritize viewings based on urgency & distance. | Book via portal chat or agent phone. | | **H. Review Lease Terms** | Pay attention to lease length, deposit amount, utilities inclusion, subletting rules. | Read contract carefully; consider legal review if needed. | --- ## Sample Email Template to Real Estate Agent ``` Subject: Inquiry – 3-Bedroom Apartment in Zürich (Move-In Date: ___) Dear [Agent Name], My name is [Your Full Name] and I am currently looking for a 3‑bedroom rental in Zürich. Below are my key requirements: - Budget: CHF _______ max/month - Preferred districts: ___________ - Move‑in date: ________________________ - Must-have features: ________________ (parking, balcony, pets allowed, etc.) - Other notes: ___________________________________________ Attached please find copies of my employment letter, recent payslips, and bank statement for reference. Could you kindly inform me of available units that match this profile? If possible, I’d appreciate scheduling a viewing next week. Thank you very much for your assistance! Best regards, [Full Name] [Phone Number] [Email Address] ``` *(Attach PDFs of documents when sending.)* --- ## Typical Rent Ranges (as of Q1 2024) | District | Avg Monthly Rent (CHF) | Notes | |-----------|-------------------------|-------| | City Centre (Altstadt, Kreis 1) | 2,500 – 3,800 | Highest demand, close to everything | | Enge / Wollishofen | 2,200 – 3,400 | Trendy, good schools | | Seefeld | 2,300 – 3,600 | Lakeside vibe, upscale | | Oerlikon | 1,900 – 3,000 | Modern apartments, near tech parks | | Zollikon / Küsnacht | 2,700 – 4,100 | Suburban, quieter, pricier | | Affoltern | 1,800 – 2,800 | Affordable, family friendly | These figures fluctuate seasonally; peak summer months see higher rents. --- ## Handy Links & Tips | Resource | Purpose | |----------|---------| | **Zürcher Immobilienportal** (`zuri.com`) | Aggregates multiple listings across Switzerland. | | **Swiss Rental Law Overview** | Understand tenant rights & obligations. | | **Expat Housing Forums** | Get anecdotal experiences from other expats. | | **Google Street View** | Virtually tour neighbourhoods before visiting. | If you'd like, I can pull up current listings directly via our internal API (if you share your credentials). Otherwise, following the steps above will get you started fast. Let me know your responses to the clarification questions, and I'll tailor the next set of recommendations accordingly!
